pattern_explanation: These Spanish words entered the language from Latin and resemble English words in spelling, but over time their meanings diverged, so the forms look alike while the meanings differ.
false_friend_warning: The Spanish words look like the English words 'actually', 'eventually', 'sensible' and 'realize', but they mean currently, possibly, sensitive and to carry out. Learners who rely on appearance will choose the English look-alike instead of the true meaning.
